title: Partite pairing traces
statement: Let $r,k$ be natural numbers with $r>0$. For each natural number $s$ and each finite set of vertices in a $2r$-partite vertex set, define the type of pairing traces recursively: at $s=0$ it has one element; at $s+1$, a trace consists of the condition that the current set is nonempty, a partner choice from the vertices in parts other than the pivot's part, and a trace of length $s$ after removing the pivot and that partner.
